36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
89361: Megumin is an archmage and the self-proclaimed top genius of the Crimson Demons, an order of magicians who are born with high intelligence and magical powers.
89362: Aqua is a goddess of water. She guides humans who die young to the afterlife. Due to her cocky attitude towards Kazuma, she ends up being dragged to another world with him to defeat the Demon King.
89363: A crusader and a masochist. Despite being an advanced knight, she is extremely clumsy and none of her attacks ever hit their mark. However, she has great endurance and stamina and acts as the frontline of the party.
89364: A hikikomori (shut-in), otaku and NEET, Kazuma arrives in the afterlife after a traffic accident and decides to go to another world to defeat the Demon King, taking Aqua with him. He has the weakest job of 'Adventurer', but has decent intelligence and extraordinarily high luck.
120652: Yunyun is a member of the Crimson Magic Clan, and she and Megumin are friends as well as rivals.
120653: Komekko is Megumin's adorable younger sister. She is a young Crimson Demon and the only Crimson Magic kid around her age.
120654: Chomusuke acts as Megumin's familiar. She is a black cat with a red cross-shaped marking on her forehead and bat like wings. She cannot speak human language, but she seems to be fairly intelligent and can understand human speech to some extent.
120655: Wiz is the owner of a famous Magic Item Shop in Axel that has many unsalable items with quirky defects. She used to be a renowned Arch Wizard, but has since retired. At night, she has a secret identity as a kind-hearted lich who helps lingering spirits pass on.
120657: Part of the Guild Staff, she is the go-to woman for adventurers visiting the guild. Luna is a very kind, caring and cheerful young woman who has a rather ''Onee-chan'' (big sister) aura about her. She has common sense which is a rarity in the Fantasy World.
120658: Eris is the Goddess of Fortune and Aqua's junior. Eris is a very kind and gentle girl who treats others with kindness and respect. She is also very caring and she always interest her adherents. She has a very cheerful attitude but at times can act a bit childish.
120659: Iris has a little-sister type personality but also acts very kind and cheerful, almost always seen with a smile on her face. As a princess, she is very polite and treats everyone with respect.
122424: Royal Prosecutor for the Kingdom of Belzerg.
126854: An anime-exclusive character. The first person Kazuma speaks with in Axel's guildhall.
136042: A dullahan and one of the Devil King's generals. He becomes hostile towards Kazuma's party after Megumin keeps using his castle for explosion practice.
136043: A frivolous archer who is part of Taylor's party.
136044: A Japanese citizen who was also reincarnated to the fantasy world by Aqua. He is one of Belzerg's strongest adventurers and wields the cursed sword Gram. The sword was his gift from Aqua.
136046: A warrior and a member of the party consisting of Rin, Keith, and Taylor. He is a major supporting character in the main KonoSuba series, as well as the protagonist of the Limelight spinoff series alongside Rin.
144536: Sylvia was a chimera and one of the eight generals of the Demon King, serving as the director of the Monster Enhancement Division. They serve as the primary antagonist of the Konosuba Movie. At first glance, Sylvia appeared as a towering, voluptuous and beautiful woman.
150136: Hyoizaburoo is Megumin's father and a magic item craftsman.
150137: Cecily is a priestess of the Axis Order. She has an attraction to young girls, which she doesn't try to hide at all.
150138: Yuiyui is the mother of Megumin and Komekko.
177157: Wolbach is a goddess that presides over violence and sloth. She serves as one of the eight generals of the Demon King and has many worshippers within the Demon King's army.
177159: Was a former Arch Wizard who later became a Lich to save his love.
177160: Is the father of Darkness and the current head of the Dustiness House.
203544: "Head Researcher" is an unnamed person who lived and died centuries before the main story begins. He is sometimes also referred to as "Idiot Inventor," "Stupid Chief Engineer," "The Scientist," or some other names along those lines.
240105: An intermediate wizard and a member of Taylor's party, alongside Keith and Dust. Rin is a highly capable magic user, although she is humble and describes herself as a rookie wizard.
242932: Taylor is a crusader and the leader of the party consisting of Dust, Keith, and Lean.
261791: Soketto is a member of the Crimson Magic Clan and a fortune teller in the Crimson Magic Village.
293459: She is a member of the Crimson Demons and Megumin's former classmate alongside Dodonko.
293460: Arue is one of Megumin's old classmates and the third highest scoring student in her class, only trailing behind Megumin and Yunyun respectively. She's an aspiring author and, according to herself, the most voluptuous among the Crimson Demons.
293462: She is a member of the Crimson Demons and Megumin's former classmate alongside Funifura.
294249: The youngest employee of the Succubus Cafe. She is introduced when she was captured by Aqua, after having been on her way to service Kazuma. Like her coworkers, she has the magical power to put people to sleep and make them dream as requested.
301895: Arnes is a greater devil who served and worshiped Wolbach, the Goddess of Sloth and Violence.
302317: Bukkororii is a member of the Crimson Demons. He is the son of a shoe-shop owner and as such is destined to become the Crimson Demons' greatest (and only) shoemaker. He is also Megumin's next-door neighbor.
305993: Zesta is the current leader of the Axis Order, who worship the goddess Aqua, and a powerful arch-priest. He also directly leads the chapter in Arcanletia, the home of the Axis Order.
307166: Ain is an adventurer in the Kingdom of Belzerg.
307167: Lott is an adventurer in the Kingdom of Belzerg.
315314: Princess Iris's guard and tutor. An aristocrat. A passionate knight devoted to Iris.
315315: A noblewoman and a mage serving as Princess Iris's tutor.

326530: She is one of the Succubi working in the "special" shop.
